decisions.reason: Changing biographies from placeholders to direct insertion does not alter the organization chart integration requirement.
The Tables document is only the location where the biographies were supplied; the source decision does not change which proposal tables must be incorporated or replaced.
Direct biography insertion does not change the required section order or permit section reordering.
The biography insertion method is owned by the separate appendix-biography requirement and does not change the existing obligation to include supplied narrative content.
The source changes how biographies are integrated but does not revise the page-count target or page-limit compliance goal.
Direct insertion of biographies does not change whether the proposal must include a table of contents.
The biography integration change does not alter the Agua Arc identity, colors, or logo requirements.
The source concerns biographies rather than required photographs or their selection and placement.
Inserting supplied biographies into the current proposal does not change the deferred reusable-template requirement.
The biography insertion method does not affect Canva ownership, editability, asset restrictions, or reuse rights.
Directly inserting biographies does not change the established full-document layout coverage, pass count, or visual approach.
The biography integration change does not alter the requirement that proposal hyperlinks remain functional.
